build: Modwerk's linker (scripts/link-image.mjs in modwerk-source-tools): the Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant ba530f45, vendored) + this folder's lfo-rnd 1.2.0, materialised against stock OS 1.74 (cb0f99d6…e123), --version LR12

emulator.name: analog-emu (trigcondition's Rytm and A4 emulator built on rytm-emu; its history holds rytm-emu c5732f0, 951dcbc and e914f46)
emulator.settings: no card image, JIT on, --every 1000M; DTBOOT_STEPS=1 DTBOOT_PNG_DIR=out DTBOOT_TURN_PNG=out

conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; a short LFO press (12M) opens BD's LFO page and a second one LFO RND; encoder 0 (DS1) turns up in twenty steps through the destination list, a zero-count turn lets the list settle, YES confirms FILT:Frequency; encoder 4 (DP1) turns up in sixteen steps. Stock 1.74 with the same input gives byte-identical frames until the second LFO press, where stock stays on the LFO page; afterwards stock's turns move LFO SPD and DEP. Playback was not judged in the emulator.
